limitations: One fresh LLM judge reviewed each case in disjoint 61/50/50 shards; these are not three independent ratings per case. The auditor checked artifact completeness and selected conclusions in addition.

Current_response is joined approved claim text or a canonical policy response, not observed Gemma/model/UI output. Static prose review cannot measure deployment behavior, response stability, actual citations, latency or cost.
Seventeen flow passes assess static authored branch context; seven pass only a local clarification. No complete adaptive runtime transition or retention behavior is certified.

The auditor read all material negative rationales and their finding fields and checked source/feedback context for substantial findings; only PDF23/PDF29 were freshly inspected visually by the auditor. Other visual inspection claims belong to named judge agents and their retained artifacts.
All findings are LLM judgments. Coverage, hashes and quote matches are mechanical checks; they are not measured production accuracy or proof of every semantic judgment.
This audit does not edit responses, change release approval, authorize undocumented repair, publish source material, validate general vision/voice performance or deploy anything.
